description: List and keyword-search federal accounts by agency identifier or title keyword. Returns account numbers, names, managing agencies, and budgetary resources. fiscal_year selects the resource amounts, not account membership; omit it for the latest available submission year. Search and detail totals use different calculations and can differ for the same year. Use account_number from results as input to usaspending_get_federal_account for full budget detail. Use usaspending_list_agencies to look up agency_identifier codes (3-digit strings, e.g. "097" for DoD).

agency_identifier.description: 3-digit agency identifier code (e.g., "097" for Department of Defense). Use usaspending_list_agencies to look up codes.

anyOf.description: Integer federal fiscal year from 2001 through the current federal fiscal year
Blank form value; leaves the fiscal year unset

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year (2001 through the current federal fiscal year; October 1 rollover). Omit or leave blank to preserve the endpoint default.

keyword.description: Filter accounts by name or title keyword (e.g., "defense", "transportation")

name: usaspending_search_federal_accounts

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fiscal_year.description: Effective fiscal year of the budgetary resources, as reported by USAspending; account membership spans all submitted years

has_next.description: Whether there are more pages of results

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes applied filters and suggests how to broaden. Absent when results are present.

count.description: Total matching accounts across all pages

has_next.description: Whether there are more pages of results

items.description: Federal account record with code, name, agency, and budget

account_number.description: Federal account code (e.g., "097-8097") — pass to usaspending_get_federal_account for full detail

agency_identifier.description: 3-digit agency identifier code for this account

budgetary_resources.description: Total budgetary resources for this account in USD

totalCount.description: Total number of matching accounts across all pages (when available)

title: Search Federal Accounts
